## stella-context/src/retrieval.rs
    1  //! The hybrid, budgeted, cited retrieval pipeline (arch §2.3).
    2  //! [`ContextStore::recall`] fuses three signals
    3  //! — vector similarity, recency, and 1-hop graph adjacency — via reciprocal-
    4  //! rank fusion, dedupes by content hash, diversifies with MMR, then **packs to
    5  //! the query's token budget and reports what was dropped** (silent truncation
    6  //! is banned, `L-C5`). Every frame carries a human `citation_label` (`L-C4`).
    7  //! When graph/vector coverage of the goal is weak, it falls back to bounded
    8  //! lexical search and **labels those frames as lexical fallback** rather than
    9  //! dressing weak context up as grounding (`L-C6`).

## docs/design/storage-map.md
   18  (`storage/py.rs`). Relational schema-as-code shares the implicit `sql`
   19  layer, so an ORM model and the DDL that materializes it resolve to one
   20  address and ring 1 exempts cross-family same-name pairs (§4a: "DDL wins
   21  field by field; the ORM definition is kept"); Mongoose and DynamoDB default
   22  to their own `mongo`/`dynamodb` layers, so the cross-layer conflict fires.
   23  The gate simulates edit_file's post-edit content, so a model gaining a
   24  field is checked as a column addition (rings 1–2) with no ALTER anywhere.
   25  **Not yet built:** ActiveRecord + `$jsonSchema` adapters and the Diesel
   26  field upgrade (§4a table), context.db embedding of the cards +
   27  `NodeKind::Storage` recall integration (§7b–c), the LLM inference fold
   28  (§5c), `stella storage init` discovery (§4c), and the Observatory panel.
   29  Ring 3 runs on name-token similarity today; embed-card cosine slots in once
   30  the cards are embedded. ORM `REFERENCES` targets are naming-derived, so
   31  orphaned-FK blocking stays SQL-only (a heuristic may warn, never block).
   32  **Goal:** On very long-horizon tasks in complex projects, the agent (a) always
   33  knows every storage layer the project uses, what belongs in each, and the full
   34  schema down to individual fields — retrievable by name *and* by meaning — and
   35  (b) finds it structurally hard to create a duplicate or misplaced schema,
   36  table, or column, in **any** storage technology, not just SQL.
   37  **Prior art:** `docs/design/schema-graph.md`. What actually shipped from it:
   38  the live SQL DDL index in `stella-graph` (tree-sitter-sequel; `SymbolKind::
   39  {Table, Column, SchemaEnum, View}`), the Diesel `table!` detector, and the
   40  pre-write gate in `stella-tools/src/schema_gate.rs` (regex scan, `.sql` files
   41  only, exact-name conflicts on tables/types/views). Its Phase 3 canonical model
   42  (`schema.rs`, `code_graph_schema_links`) and Phase 4 semantic edges are
